title: Range reversal
contract: Reverse [start,end) and preserve all outside positions.
scope: Lists length 0..3 over -1,0,1; all legal endpoints.
assumptions: Exactly the abstract finite model and input domain described in scope; no claim about LLMLang implementation or unbounded executions.

obligations.claim: Same length; each inside position has its mirrored original value; every outside position is unchanged.
